verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH/terminal client focused on host management, connectivity, snippets and SFTP. Stashing and unstashing git changes is a version-control feature outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Termius ships any git or source-control capability. Typing git commands into a remote shell would be a user-side workaround, not a Termius feature.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can stash and unstash changes to temporarily clear my working directory
